functions.name: PHONE
functions.description: Validates a phone number and returns carrier, line type (Mobile/VoIP/Landline), or formatted E.164.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Phone number in E.164 (+14155552671) or national format.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country code hint (e.g. US, IN, GB).

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Optional field: summary (default), status, linetype, carrier, formatted, voip, country.

functions.name: WHATSAPP
functions.description: Silently checks whether a phone number is registered on WhatsApp (Personal or Business).

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Phone number in E.164 (+919876543210) or national format.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country code hint (e.g. IN, BR, AE).

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Optional field: summary (default), registered, business, type.

functions.name: EMAIL
functions.description: Verifies email MX/mailbox deliverability and detects disposable 10-minute temp-mail domains.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address to verify (e.g. buyer@company.com).

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Optional field: verdict (default), deliverable, disposable, type, domain, reason.

functions.name: CALLERID
functions.description: Looks up registered Caller ID (CNAM) subscriber name and optionally matches against lead name.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Phone number in E.164 or national format.

parameters.name: lead_name
parameters.description: Optional customer or company name to compare (returns MATCH / PARTIAL / MISMATCH).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country code hint (e.g. US, IN).

functions.name: DNSBL
functions.description: Screens a corporate domain or IP against 50+ DNSBL spam & malware blocklists.

parameters.name: domain_or_ip
parameters.description: Corporate domain, email address, or IPv4/IPv6 address.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Optional field: summary (default), listed, count.

functions.name: IPGEO
functions.description: Resolves IP geolocation, ISP/ASN, VPN/hosting detection, and billing country mismatch.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: Public IPv4 or IPv6 address (e.g. 8.8.8.8).

parameters.name: country_hint
parameters.description: Optional expected 2-letter billing country code to flag mismatches.

functions.name: TRUSTSCORE
functions.description: Calculates a composite 0-100 Lead & COD Fraud Trust Score across Phone, WhatsApp, Email, CNAM & IP.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Phone number (optional if email provided).

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address (optional if phone provided).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. US, IN).

parameters.name: lead_name
parameters.description: Optional customer/lead full name for Caller ID matching.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: Optional customer IP address for GeoIP & VPN screening.
